kind: observed semantic comparison; passing tests do not imply universal capability parity
scope: Cordis kernel versus Aalis Context; Aalis whenService is not a PluginManager activation test

observations.desiredScenario: Several implementations compete for a default within one service scope
observations.interpretation: Intentional contract: one provider per isolation label; use explicit scopes for multiple implementations.

observations.desiredScenario: Override one branch without affecting the parent or sibling
observations.interpretation: Achieved by explicit isolate(); extend() alone inherits, and empty isolated services do not fall back.

observations.desiredScenario: Join selected service scopes without exposing the service at the root
observations.interpretation: Achieved by reusing the same isolation label.

observations.desiredScenario: Wait for a service and cleanly attach to its replacement
observations.interpretation: inject() gates the entire dependent Fiber and restarts it when the provider changes.

observations.desiredScenario: Parent unload removes nested registrations and resources
observations.interpretation: Achieved for resources registered through effects and child fibers.

observations.desiredScenario: Await disposal until asynchronous cleanup completes
observations.interpretation: Fiber.dispose() waits for registered asynchronous effects.

observations.desiredScenario: Resources created through a shared service follow the caller lifetime
observations.interpretation: Traceable Service proxies transfer effect ownership to the calling Fiber, including across an await.

observations.desiredScenario: Resources created through a shared service follow the caller lifetime
observations.interpretation: Traceable Service proxies transfer effect ownership to the calling Fiber, including across an await.

observations.desiredScenario: Route an event to one logical branch
observations.interpretation: Explicit Context.filter receiver selects the branch; global listeners intentionally bypass filtering.

observations.desiredScenario: Keep a provider resource usable until dependent cleanup has completed
observations.interpretation: Not automatic across independent top-level effects: unload runs them concurrently. This contract needs deliberate resource composition.

observations.desiredScenario: Keep a provider resource usable until dependent cleanup has completed
observations.interpretation: Achieved with an explicit composite effect that unregisters the service before closing its resource.

observations.desiredScenario: Several implementations compete for a default within one service scope
observations.interpretation: Achieved through shared-container arbitration and explicit preference.

observations.desiredScenario: Override one branch without affecting the parent or sibling
observations.interpretation: Not obtained from fork(): descendants intentionally share the same ServiceContainer. This is a different scope contract, not a failed cleanup.

observations.desiredScenario: Join selected service scopes without exposing the service at the root
observations.interpretation: fork() shares the entire container; it is not a per-service isolation-label mechanism.

observations.desiredScenario: Wait for a service and cleanly attach to its replacement
observations.interpretation: whenService() reattaches the callback and cleans its returned disposer; this test does not measure PluginManager dependency gating.

observations.desiredScenario: Parent unload removes nested registrations and resources
observations.interpretation: Achieved for Context registrations and resources explicitly registered with onDispose().

observations.desiredScenario: Await disposal until asynchronous cleanup completes
observations.interpretation: Achieved with disposeAsync(); the separate synchronous dispose() API intentionally does not wait.

observations.desiredScenario: Resources created through a shared service follow the caller lifetime
observations.interpretation: Not automatic for a service that captures the provider Context. Aalis returns the bare instance; explicitly pass the caller or register a caller cleanup.

observations.desiredScenario: Resources created through a shared service follow the caller lifetime
observations.interpretation: Not automatic for a service that captures the provider Context. Aalis returns the bare instance; explicitly pass the caller or register a caller cleanup.

observations.desiredScenario: Resources created through a shared service follow the caller lifetime
observations.interpretation: Achieved with an explicit owner argument; the difference from Cordis is automatic context rebinding, not whether cleanup can be implemented.

observations.desiredScenario: Route an event to one logical branch
observations.interpretation: fork() uses a shared EventBus. Branch selection requires application-level routing/filtering rather than Context event scope.
